units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|This planet is populated by a hostile alien species that resembles giant, intelligent squirrels. Although despite their hostility while in orbit, they pay little mind to you on the surface. Do you want to approach one of them?|22|0
units.english: This planet is populated by a hostile alien species that resembles giant, intelligent squirrels. Although despite their hostility while in orbit, they pay little mind to you on the surface. Do you want to approach one of them?
units.italian: Questo pianeta è popolato da una specie aliena ostile che somiglia a scoiattoli giganti e intelligenti. Sebbene, nonostante la loro ostilità in orbita, in superficie non ti badano quasi. Vuoi avvicinarti a uno di loro?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	(Sure.)|24|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	(Not now, it's too risky.)|26|0
units.english: (Not now, it's too risky.)
units.italian: (Non ora, è troppo rischioso.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	You catch the eye of one of the alien dock workers and it walks over. "Ah," it says, "the monkey is curious. The monkey has never been face to face with a true Hai before?"|30|0
units.english: You catch the eye of one of the alien dock workers and it walks over. "Ah," it says, "the monkey is curious. The monkey has never been face to face with a true Hai before?"
units.italian: Incontri lo sguardo di uno degli alieni che lavorano alla banchina e lui si avvicina. "Ah," dice, "la scimmia è curiosa. La scimmia non è mai stata faccia a faccia con un vero Hai?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Hai? Is that what you call yourselves?"|32|0
units.english: "Hai? Is that what you call yourselves?"
units.italian: "Hai? È così che vi chiamate?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"What do you mean, 'true Hai'?"|34|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'true Hai'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi con 'veri Hai'?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Why did you shoot at me? Are you at war?"|36|0
units.english: "Why did you shoot at me? Are you at war?"
units.italian: "Perché mi avete sparato? Siete in guerra?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|The Hai here appear to be at war with the rest of their species. Do you want to approach one of them and ask why?|40|0
units.english: The Hai here appear to be at war with the rest of their species. Do you want to approach one of them and ask why?
units.italian: Gli Hai qui sembrano in guerra con il resto della loro specie. Vuoi avvicinarti a uno di loro e chiedere perché?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	(Sure.)|42|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	(Not now, it's too risky.)|43|0
units.english: (Not now, it's too risky.)
units.italian: (Non ora, è troppo rischioso.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	You catch the eye of one of the Hai dock workers and they walk over. "Ah," they say, "the monkey is curious. The monkey has never been face to face with a true Hai before?"|45|0
units.english: You catch the eye of one of the Hai dock workers and they walk over. "Ah," they say, "the monkey is curious. The monkey has never been face to face with a true Hai before?"
units.italian: Uno degli Hai che lavorano alla banchina incrocia il tuo sguardo e si avvicina. "Ah," dice, "la scimmia è curiosa. La scimmia non è mai stata faccia a faccia con un vero Hai?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"No, I've encountered many of your brethren south of here."|47|0
units.english: "No, I've encountered many of your brethren south of here."
units.italian: "No, ho incontrato molti dei tuoi simili a sud di qui."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"What do you mean, 'true Hai'?"|49|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'true Hai'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi con 'veri Hai'?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Why are you at war with everyone else?"|51|0
units.english: "Why are you at war with everyone else?"
units.italian: "Perché siete in guerra con tutti gli altri?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	They hiss. "They are not true Hai. We are Hai. The unaltered. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."|55|0
units.english: They hiss. "They are not true Hai. We are Hai. The unaltered. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."
units.italian: Sibila. "Non sono veri Hai. Noi siamo gli Hai. Gli inalterati. Eravamo padroni di cento mondi quando le scimmie umane non avevano ancora imparato a usare i pollici."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"It means that we are unaltered, Hai as Hai were first born to be. Hai the conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."|59|0
units.english: "It means that we are unaltered, Hai as Hai were first born to be. Hai the conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."
units.italian: "Significa che siamo inalterati, Hai come gli Hai furono creati all'inizio. Gli Hai conquistatori. Eravamo padroni di cento mondi quando le scimmie umane non avevano ancora imparato a usare i pollici."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"We are Hai. Hai the conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."|63|0
units.english: "We are Hai. Hai the conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."
units.italian: "Noi siamo gli Hai. Gli Hai conquistatori. Eravamo padroni di cento mondi quando le scimmie umane non avevano ancora imparato a usare i pollici."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"We fight to defend ourselves from extinction," they say.|67|0
units.english: "We fight to defend ourselves from extinction," they say.
units.italian: "Combattiamo per difenderci dall'estinzione," dicono.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Extinction?" you ask. "Do you mean that there are no other Hai?"|68|0
units.english: "Extinction?" you ask. "Do you mean that there are no other Hai?"
units.italian: "Estinzione?" chiedi. "Vuoi dire che non ci sono altri Hai?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"We are all that is left of the original Hai," they say. "Unaltered. The conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."|69|0
units.english: "We are all that is left of the original Hai," they say. "Unaltered. The conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."
units.italian: "Siamo tutto ciò che resta degli Hai originali," dicono. "Inalterati. I conquistatori. Eravamo padroni di cento mondi quando le scimmie umane non avevano ancora imparato a usare i pollici."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"We fight to defend ourselves from extinction," they say.|73|0
units.english: "We fight to defend ourselves from extinction," they say.
units.italian: "Combattiamo per difenderci dall'estinzione," dicono.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Extinction?" you ask. "Do you mean that you are not the same species as the other Hai?"|74|0
units.english: "Extinction?" you ask. "Do you mean that you are not the same species as the other Hai?"
units.italian: "Estinzione?" chiedi. "Vuoi dire che non siete la stessa specie degli altri Hai?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Indeed," they say. "We are all that is left of the original Hai. Unaltered. The conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."|75|0
units.english: "Indeed," they say. "We are all that is left of the original Hai. Unaltered. The conquerors. We were masters of a hundred worlds before human monkeys had learned the use of thumbs."
units.italian: "Esatto," dicono. "Siamo tutto ciò che resta degli Hai originali. Inalterati. I conquistatori. Eravamo padroni di cento mondi quando le scimmie umane non avevano ancora imparato a usare i pollici."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"Where was your territory? Why have I never heard of you before?"|80|0
units.english: "Where was your territory? Why have I never heard of you before?"
units.italian: "Dov'era il vostro territorio? Perché non ho mai sentito parlare di voi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Unfettered|	"What do you mean, the Hai were altered?"|81|0
units.english: "What do you mean, the Hai were altered?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi con 'gli Hai sono stati alterati'?"
